Chapter 6762: Setting Sun

Chapter 6762: Setting Sun

Her expression changed as she fell into silence.

“It can be frustrating being an immortal, especially with ancient races. Too many things can’t be let go, and somehow, time only makes it worse. They become stagnant and rigid, such immortals can’t reach the shore and definitely can’t let go.” He said.

“Young Noble, do you think the primordial race can let go?” She couldn’t help but ask.

“Only one or two. In their case, it’s not due to stagnation and attachments but rather, greed.” He said: “Divine beasts are the ones who will fall due to stagnation.”

“The divine beasts have proven their tenacity with time, they will survive.” She disagreed.

“Just the last sunset.” He smiled.

The conversation came to a halt. The lord saw the horde of beasts and asked Li Qiye: “Immortal, how is my daughter?”

“She is fine, just overexerted herself. A break will be plenty.” Li Qiye said.

“Why did she change so much?” He didn’t understand.

“She’s releasing the eaten divine artifact.” Li Qiye smiled.

“...” The lord only became more confused: “I thought it wasn’t there anymore.”

“It’s because she has the gluttonous beast bloodline.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Gluttonous beast.” He murmured. He once thought there was something wrong with his daughter’s intelligence. Now, it turned out she had the bloodline of a beast.

***

The gathering of beasts attracted cultivators in Beastmaster World. Azure Plain was a popular destination for those seeking suitable heavenly beasts. Thus, news traveled fast.

“Ferocious Ocean is appearing again, even emperor beasts are there.”

The appearance of even ancestor beasts made emperors and ancient ancestors travel to Azure Plain with haste.

“What an opportunity.” This was on everyone’s mind.

Although not all wanted to start a pact, the more powerful cultivators wanted to catch them for different reasons.

“I want this hawk.” A big shot saw a hawk and wanted to make a pact, not giving up after several attempts.

This eventually infuriated the hawk, causing it to pierce the cultivator with its feathers and ending his life.

Another pleased a turtle by presenting it with gifts and food. Eventually, beast runes appeared and the cultivator signed a dao pact with the turtle.

The fire emperor elephant was a highly coveted beast. Of course, one needed to be an emperor to even try.

However, if one somehow gained an emperor-level beast’s approval despite being weaker, they could sign the pact after becoming an emperor.

Unfortunately, the elephant ignored everyone. Its patience was limited and as time passed, it spewed out flames and killed a dozen cultivators nearby. This taught everyone else a lesson and made them keep their distance.

“Go!” One big shot used a treasure to take in several hundred beasts that were one or two levels lower than him.

“That’s an elder from Yellow Sky, it’s incredible.” Many were in awe of both him and his treasure.

“People from Yellow Sky, Rainbow, and Sky Zenith are all here.” Others didn’t dare to compete with the prestigious big shots.

These three lineages had emperors and even ancient ancestors. They decided everything in Beastmaster World.

Nothing good came from opposing them. Death was a relatively good outcome; clan or sect destruction was always a possibility.

***

Li Qiye sipped tea while watching the show. Many cultivators found it strange that a mortal was here.

However, he didn’t interfere with anyone so they also ignored him.

“Not bad.” Li Qiye remarked while staring at the girl.

“Splash!” She leapt out of the water and landed before him, opening her mouth to release a saber.

The blade looked like white bone with a frightening gleam. Within was divinity and murderous energy.

It also let out a roar that alerted many heavenly beasts.

“A divine artifact!” Some big shots noticed and stared in its direction.
